comment_letters.topic: non-GAAP (full non-GAAP P&L; upfront and milestone exclusion)
comment_letters.staff_ask: Staff said Pfizer's reconciliation was effectively a full non-GAAP income statement and questioned excluding upfront and milestone payments on collaborations from Adjusted Income.
comment_letters.company_answer: Pfizer first defended the above-threshold exclusion, then after calls with staff agreed from Q1 2022 to include acquired IPR&D (upfronts, milestones, asset acquisitions) in non-GAAP and recast prior periods, and replaced the reconciliation tables.
comment_letters.next_filing_disclosure: FY2022 10-K shows Acquired IPR&D as its own line: $953M (2022), $3,469M (2021), $684M (2020); these now hit Adjusted income.
comment_letters.why_it_matters: Before 2022 Pfizer's adjusted EPS (also a pay metric) excluded the largest licensing deals; the SEC forced them back in, which changes any multi-year adjusted EPS trend that crosses 2021.
comment_letters.impact_estimate: 2021 acquired IPR&D $3.47B; at ~5.7B diluted shares ~$0.6/share pre-tax that the old policy could exclude (only above-threshold deals were excluded, so true recast is smaller).
comment_letters.staff_quote: Here you include in note I adjustments to exclude the upfront and milestone payments made for collaboration agreements from Research and developments expense and net income attributable to Pfizer Inc. common shareholders.
comment_letters.reply_quote: After consulting with the Staff, we hereby undertake to change our future filings to include in our externally reported Non-GAAP financial measures expenses for (a) acquired in-process research and development costs incurred in connection with upfront and milestone payments on collaboration and in-license agreements, including premiums on equity securities and (b) asset acquisitions of acquired in-process research and development.

comment_letters.staff_ask: Staff said the offer to modify employee PSAs and TSRUs could not exclude holders by jurisdiction or by hire date without a compensatory purpose.
comment_letters.company_answer: Pfizer revised the eligibility disclosure on pages 1, 7, 8 and 17.
comment_letters.why_it_matters: Pfizer re-cut outstanding performance awards in 2024; relevant context for pay-for-performance in task 2 but not a disclosure finding.
comment_letters.staff_quote: While you need not disseminate offer materials in jurisdictions where you may not legally do so, you must accept elections to participate from all eligible holders who elect to participate in the Modification Offer.
comment_letters.reply_quote: Pfizer respectfully acknowledges the Staff's comment and has revised the relevant disclosure regarding the eligible participants on pages 1, 7, 8, and 17 accordingly.

Pfizer has never disclosed a rate or a dollar cost for its MFN pricing agreement: the terms are confidential, the CEO refused to quantify it ('no matter how much you torture us'), and in Q2 2026 he deflected a question on the final binding agreements; so any model using a Pfizer-sourced MFN rate such as 0.65% is using a number that is not in Pfizer's filings. Impact: nugget dRev (bull, base, bear) (241, 241, 742) x CM 1.00 x (1 - t 0.1854) / D 5,699.0 (line revenue; estimate from nugget PFE-nugget-006).

Selling the 11.7% ViiV stake for $1.875B also ended a dividend of $265M to $272M a year that sat inside adjusted income, so adjusted pretax income loses about $265M a year from H2 2026: a 14% pretax yield given up to add BD capacity. Impact: nugget pre-tax effect below operating income (bull, base, bear) (154, 265, 272) x (1 - t 0.1854) / D 5,699.0 (line EPS; estimate from nugget PFE-nugget-010).

rows.sentence: The Vyndamax settlements that Pfizer says give it 'greater confidence' in high single-digit growth from 2029 allow generics on June 1, 2031 only 'subject to the outcome of other litigation': Apotex is still litigating in Delaware, the basic patent runs on an interim extension to December 2026 with the 2028 extension still pending, and FDA's Paragraph IV list shows a new tablet challenger filed July 24, 2026.
